entities.summary: The Municipal Theater Cecilia Gallerani is a small theater and opera house located in San Giovanni in Croce, Italy. Since 2002, it has been dedicated to Cecilia Gallerani, the woman immortalized by Leonardo da Vinci in the portrait Lady with an Ermine.
